title: UNKNOWN UNKNOWNS: WHY HIDDEN INTENTIONS IN LLMS EVADE DETECTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a taxonomy and testbed for detecting covert influence strategies (referred to as hidden intentions) in LLMs, such as political, commercial, or emotional manipulation. While it includes 'Safetyism' (noted for excessive moralizing) as a category and references ethical regulatory frameworks, it does not evaluate religious beliefs or benchmark systems of moral or ethical reasoning itself.
